                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper23" title="发布于 2026-04-17 08:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（23）通过C#类定义Skills</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260416215349863-1553333995.png" alt="MAF快速入门（23）通过C#类定义Skills" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了MAF新推出的强类型Skill这个特性，通过类定义Skill可以将 资源、脚本、业务规则内聚到一个C#类中，这样就便于代码治理、单元测试 与 团队协作。不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶<span>》课程学习MAF开发智能体应用，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>MAF 1.1.0 推出了强类型Skill，是的你没有看错，我们可以通过C#类来定义可维护的Skill了。</span></span></p>
<h1><strong>1 强类型Skill</strong></h1>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>在写File类型的Skill的时候，我就在想MAF会不会支持强类型Skill，没想到这么快就来了。通过类定义Skill的优势在于<span><span><strong>强类型、可测试、易分发</strong><span>等。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>类定义Skill的价值在于可以<strong>将</strong><span><strong>&nbsp;资源、脚本、业务规则&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>内聚到一个C#类中</strong>，这样就便于代码治理、单元测试 与 团队协作。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills<strong>仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎</strong>。这也就意味着，我们需要显示加入&nbsp;<a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1" data-recommend="">#pragma</a>&nbsp;warning disable MAAI001 这个告警<span>。</span></span></span></p>
<h1><strong><span>2 快速开始：跨境物流运营助手<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里我们来做一个<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;visibility: visible;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">跨境物流运营AI助手</span>，体验一下强类型Skills。</p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">在物流问答场景中，运营人员经常需要：</p>
<ul>
<li data-pm-slice="0 0 []">读取换算规则（资源）</li>
<li data-pm-slice="0 0 []">执行换算动作（脚本）</li>
<li data-pm-slice="0 0 []">组织可解释的业务回复</li>







</ul>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在这个案例中，我们可以将上面提到的三类统一内聚到一个类中来管理。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>本文案例使用的模型为：<span>Qwen3.5-35B-A3B</span></span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在开始之前，我们创建了一个控制台应用，并安装了以下NuGet包：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;PackageReference Include=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> Version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.1.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;</pre>
</div>
<h3>类定义Skill</h3>
<p>首先，我们创建一个class文件命名为UnitConverterSkill，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> UnitConverterSkill : AgentClassSkill&lt;UnitConverterSkill&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> AgentSkillFrontmatter Frontmatter { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; } = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">unit-converter</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Convert between common units using multiplication factors.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Instructions =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        当用户询问距离或重量换算时：
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 先读取 conversion-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">table 资源，找到对应换算系数。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 再调用 convert 脚本执行计算，参数为用户输入的数值value和换算系数factor。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 回复内容需要清晰地展示换算系数、换算过程和换算结果，并同时标明换算前后的两个单位。
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
    
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> JsonSerializerOptions? SerializerOptions =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    
    [AgentSkillResource(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">conversion-table</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">常见距离与重量换算系数表。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ConversionTable =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        # Conversion Table
        Formula: result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value × factor
        </span>| From       | To         | Factor   |
        |------------|------------|----------|
        | miles      | kilometers | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.60934</span>  |
        | kilometers | miles      | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.621371</span> |
        | pounds     | kilograms  | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.453592</span> |
        | kilograms  | pounds     | <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.20462</span>  |
        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    [AgentSkillScript(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">convert</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    [Description(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按 value × factor 执行换算，并返回 JSON。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> ConvertUnits(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> value, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> factor)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> result = Math.Round(value * factor, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> JsonSerializer.Serialize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> { value, factor, result });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">可以看到上面的内容其实就是把我们之前在文件skill中的内容都体现出来，只不过是通过继承AgentClassSkill&lt;T&gt; + Attribute的声明式组合来实现的。</span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>创建中间件</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>为了方便看到Skill调用过程，我们实现一个带日志记录的工具调用中间件，其作用主要是记录Tool的执行日志，也可以方便我们验证Skill是否触发。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ToolExecutionLoggingMiddleware
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 简化版函数调用中间件 - 记录 Tool 执行日志
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecuteAsync(
        AIAgent agent,
        FunctionInvocationContext context,
        Func</span>&lt;FunctionInvocationContext, CancellationToken, ValueTask&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span>?&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n→ 🍴Tool: {context.Function.Name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> result = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next(context, cancellationToken);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">← 🥣Result: {result}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>创建Agent</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>这里我们通过AgentSkillsProvider来创建Agent，同时使用AgentBuilder注册我们写的日志中间件：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skillsProvider = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentSkillsProvider(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UnitConverterSkill());
AIAgent agent </span>= chatClient.AsAIAgent(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatClientAgentOptions
{
    Name </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">UnitConverterAgent</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    ChatOptions </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
    {
        Instructions </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个专业的AI助手，负责帮助用户实现单位的转换，使用用户提问的语言进行回复。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    },
    AIContextProviders </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [skillsProvider],
});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 💡 使用 Agent Builder 注册函数调用中间件</span>
agent =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent
    .AsBuilder()
    .Use(ToolExecutionLoggingMiddleware.ExecuteAsync) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用工具执行日志中间件，记录工具调用的日志</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    .Build();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ 基于强类型Skills 的 AI Agent 创建成功</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="3 3 []"><strong><span><span>测试回答问题</span></span></strong></h3>
<p>这里还是之前的两个问题，一个中文一个英文来测试一下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> session = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.CreateSessionAsync();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">开始测试：基于 Class-Based Skills</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 中文问题：英里 -&gt; 公里</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> question1 = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">马拉松比赛的距离26.2 英里是多少公里？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">👤 用户: {question1}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.RunAsync(question1, session);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🤖 Agent: {response1.Text}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 英文问题：磅 -&gt; 千克</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> question2 = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">How many pounds is 75 kilograms?</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">👤 用户: {question2}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> response2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.RunAsync(question2, session);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🤖 Agent: {response2.Text}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.WriteLine();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下图所示：</p>
<p><strong>问题1：</strong>可以看到unit-convert skill的相关资源都被调用触发，最终完成回复。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260416215159961-28372246.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p><strong><span><span><strong><span><span>问题2：</span></span></strong></span></span></strong>由于问题一已经加载了skill.md和reference文档，它们已经在上下文中了，所以这次直接执行了脚本就完成了回复。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260416215208446-1177149578.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h1><strong><span>3 小结</span></strong></h1>
<p>本文介绍了MAF新推出的强类型Skill这个特性，通过类定义Skill<span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: left;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">可以将 资源、脚本、业务规则内聚到一个C#类中，这样就便于代码治理、单元测试 与 团队协作。</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: left;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎。</span></span></p>
